schedule: Sequential fresh workers, rotating methods; each writes an untimed verification archive, warms once, then measures three complete ZIP responses to a counting in-memory sink. Warm reads; natural GC; no explicit collection. Both streaming baselines use 64 KiB uncompressed flush targets and yield every 2,048 rows. Uses the public ExportLite ZIP option and varies only its existing bufferSize option. Timings include compression, checksums, ZIP finalization and destination completion; exclude process/module startup, verification, disk, HTTP and network. RSS is a process high-water mark including startup, verification, warmup and three timed exports.
